Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp

Class TotpController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.totp.TotpController
All Implemented Interfaces:
TotpApi
@RestController public class TotpController extends Object implements TotpApi
Enrols, confirms and disables the authenticator app of the authenticated account. The paths, status codes and bodies are those of the contract apis/auth-server/rest-server/auth-server-api-v1.yaml, through the generated TotpApi; failures are answered by MfaExceptionHandler. Answers that carry a secret are never cached. Disabling the app needs a recent multi-factor sign-in (StepUpGuard).
